name: n8n
description: Workflow automation platform with 400+ integrations and agent nodes.
descriptionZh: 工作流自动化平台，含 400+ 集成与 Agent 节点。
keyFact: n8n is a fair-code, source-available workflow automation platform founded in Berlin in 2019; it offers 400+ integrations plus inline JavaScript/Python code nodes and MCP support, and its Community Edition is free to self-host without an execution cap.
keyFactZh: n8n 是 2019 年创立于柏林的 fair-code、source-available 工作流自动化平台；提供 400+ 集成、内联 JavaScript/Python 代码节点与 MCP 支持，其社区版可免费自托管且无执行次数上限。
caveat: Source-available under the Sustainable Use License, not OSI-approved open source; enterprise features are separately licensed.
caveatZh: 采用 Sustainable Use License 的 source-available 模式，非 OSI 认证的开源许可；企业功能需单独授权。
